integrity: The primary full text was checked at the dual-quermassintegral definition, the rectangle second variation, the threshold function P(Q), the dimension-reduction formula, and the endpoint theorem. The endpoint rectangle integral is evaluated directly and the all-dimensional statement uses the source's stated uniform degeneration.
scientific_limitations: The exact quartic formula is for the source's planar rectangle family. In dimensions above two, the stated profile is the thin-box limit as the transverse thickness tends to zero. No universal endpoint stability modulus for all origin-symmetric convex bodies is claimed.
title: Quartic stabilization of the rectangle obstruction at the dual Brunn–Minkowski endpoint
